description: Begin a bounded hosted graph synchronization with four plain-language changeNarrative sections written manually by the publishing agent.

changeNarrative.description: Write four short, privacy-filtered summaries: added, updated, removed and relationships. Describe what changed in the graph; use a plain statement when a section has no changes.

declaredCanonicalBytes.description: Expected canonical byte count across all chunks.

declaredChunkCount.description: Total number of chunks the complete upload will contain.

declaredEdgeCount.description: Total number of graph edges declared for the upload.

declaredNodeCount.description: Total number of graph nodes declared for the upload.

declaredProseBytes.description: Expected number of prose bytes in the graph upload.

executionId.description: Execution record ID returned when the execution was registered; associates this call with that execution. Not a session or project ID.

expectedProjectVersion.description: Current hosted project version from the latest project status read; guards against overwriting a newer graph publication.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated retry key. Reuse the same key and identical payload only to retry the same mutation; use a new key for a new action.

mappedRevision.description: Local revision identifier represented by the submitted mapping.

projectId.description: Owned Brain Scanner project ID from the account's project list; not a local path or repository URL.

sessionId.description: ID of this project's active agent session, returned when the session was started. Not needed for read-only calls.

name: begin_project_sync
title: Begin graph upload
